subject: LOCK MODE clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.5.9.4 7) 'that maximum shall be at least 15' OK. §9.1.13.8 4) 'I-O status = 54 ... this file connector holds the maximum number of locks' OK, and 3) = 53 for the run unit. Code: under Multiple, ReleasePriorRecordLocks returns early, so a connector keeps several locks. ConnectorLockMax = 15 and RunUnitLockMax = 255 (both exactly the floors). PreflightNewLock answers 54 or 53 BEFORE acquiring, which makes the statement unsuccessful. Probe rt1.cob phase 2 control C2 (ALL OTHER, MANUAL MULTIPLE): 15 x '00', then '54' on the 16th and 17th. 'will not deny them access to records that are not locked' holds: the conflict check is per record id (IsLockedByOther). Covering tests: conformance:cases/9.1.13.8-Record-operation-conflict-condition-with-unsuccessful/pb338_read_lock_limit_position (54 on both Format 1 and Format 2), and for the run-unit half unit:CobolFileLockTests.RunUnitLockLimit_256thRunUnitLock_Is53. The 'implementor shall specify' maxima (15/255) are not yet in the user documentation docs/CONFORMANCE.md. That obligation is carried by Annex A.1 items 154/155 (separate DOC rows; see dossier_gaps). kb/Work PB707 (open) owns the neighbouring defect that WriteShared/RewriteShared discard the RETRY phrase on a 53/54 denial, which is a §14.7.9 question, not a GR7 one.
